---
title: "Dates"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

# Load data
kimball <- read_csv(
  "data/kimball.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |> 
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x != ""))

# Prepare monthly correspondence counts
kimball_monthly <- kimball |> 
  mutate(
    parsed_date = suppressWarnings(mdy(date))
  ) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(parsed_date),
    parsed_date <= as.Date("1889-12-31")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    month = floor_date(parsed_date, "month")
  ) |> 
  count(month)

# Create timeline
plot_ly(
  kimball_monthly,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~n,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  text = ~paste(
    "<b>Month:</b>", format(month, "%B %Y"),
    "<br><b>Letters:</b>", n
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7)
) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Frederick J. Kimball Correspondence by Month",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      tickformat = "%Y",
      dtick = "M12"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Number of Letters"
    ),
    margin = list(
      b = 80
    )
  ) |> 
  config(
    displayModeBar = FALSE
  )
```
